title: Portfolio entry
description: One portfolio in the Awesome GitHub Pages Portfolios list. One file per portfolio, stored in data/portfolios/.

name.description: Display name: your name, your handle or the template's name.

repo.description: GitHub repository that holds the source, as owner/name.

demo.description: Public HTTPS URL of the live site.

description.description: Optional one-line pitch shown on the gallery. Falls back to the GitHub repository description.

tags.description: Optional lowercase keywords used for filtering on the gallery (e.g. react, minimal, dark, resume, blog).

added.description: Optional. Date the entry was added, as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the date this file was first committed.
